title: Duality and Nothingness
excerpt: Duality only exists within the human mind — and a note about why he writes any of this down at all.

body: however i think it's important for these religions to remain regardless if i have a different view on them. such as buddhism and hinduism. because it is important to be aware of this nothingness. everything requires balance. its good that these religions remain as a resource for those who are blinded by desire to be reminded of the nothingness before the obsession. only when one truly experiences the nothingness can one let go and be free from any conceptual burdens that we OURSELVES place on this world. no matter how separate it may seem, it all starts within you and therefore is complete with you.
anyways im pretty sure duality only exists within the human mind. god's infinite nothingness/everythingness only is.

anyways im grateful for my hunger, and its you guys and my conception of not wanting to be alone in my knowledge that always wills me to write these things down and post it. if it wasn't for this "reason" i would never have the will to sit down and write it. thats why im scared, cuz one day i wanna write my own book on my own philosophy but what if i cant. anyways, the things i post here due to wanting to share it w a group of ppl may be the only resource i have in a future where i want to write a book.
